title: Two Checks at Once
setup: Your bishop on a7 rakes the long diagonal down to g1, and your own knight on d4 blocks it.
hint: Count how many of your pieces would be giving check the instant the knight leaves d4.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nxe2+}} is a double check: the knight hits g1 from e2 and the bishop hits it along the a7-g1 diagonal. A double check can only be met by a king move, so Rxe2 is illegal, and next move the knight simply walks away, having won the queen for nothing.
